title: An open estimate with no approved work shows "$0.00" in every money column, including Total
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. All money columns are turned on.
3. A ZZAUTOTEST open estimate exists with no approved line items.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and open the Estimates tab.
2. Find the seeded estimate's row and read every money column.
custom_expected:
1. Every money column — Labor Earned, Labor Remaining, Parts Earned, Parts Remaining, Earned, Remaining, and Total — shows "$0.00".
2. The row still appears in the Estimates tab (it is not hidden for having no value).
